parts.text:
{
  "extractions": [
    {
      "unit": "F001",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "kind": "prohibition",
        "scope_quotes": [
          "F001",
          "F002:F004"
        ],
        "scope_text": "Except as provided in paragraph (b) of 49 CFR 1540.111, when performance has begun of the inspection of an individual's person or accessible property before entering a sterile area, or before boarding an aircraft for which screening is conducted under this subchapter; when the individual is entering or in a sterile area; or when the individual is attempting to board or onboard an aircraft for which screening is conducted under §§ 1544.201, 1546.201, or 1562.23 of this chapter.",
        "context_quotes": [
          "F000"
        ],
        "modality_quote": "may not",
        "modality": "must_not",
        "alternative_quotes": [
          "F002",
          "F003",
          "F004"
        ],
        "choice_quote": "F002:F004",
        "choice_text": "The prohibition applies under any of the following circumstances: (1) when performance has begun of the inspection of the individual's person or accessible property before entering a sterile area, or before boarding an aircraft screened under this subchapter; (2) when entering or in a sterile area; or (3) when attempting to board or onboard an aircraft screened under §§ 1544.201, 1546.201, or 1562.23.",
        "logic_quote": "F003",
        "references": [
          "paragraph (b)",
          "§§ 1544.201",
          "1546.201",
          "1562.23"
        ],
        "statement": "Except as provided in paragraph (b) of 49 CFR 1540.111, an individual may not have a weapon, explosive, or incendiary, on or about the individual's person or accessible property when inspection has begun before entering a sterile area or boarding a screened aircraft, when entering or in a sterile area, or when attempting to board or onboard a screened aircraft."
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F005",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "kind": "exemption",
        "scope_quotes": [
          "F005",
          "F006:F008"
        ],
        "scope_text": "Governs carriage of firearms and other weapons on or about an individual's person or accessible property if the individual is one of the qualifying individuals specified in paragraphs (b)(1) through (b)(3).",
        "context_quotes": [
          "F001"
        ],
        "modality_quote": "does not apply",
        "modality": "not_required",
        "alternative_quotes": [
          "F006",
          "F007",
          "F008"
        ],
        "choice_quote": "F005:F008",
        "choice_text": "Paragraph (a) does not apply if the individual is: (1) law enforcement personnel required to carry a firearm or other weapons while in the performance of law enforcement duty at the airport; (2) an individual authorized to carry a weapon in accordance with §§ 1544.219, 1544.221, 1544.223, 1546.211, or subpart B of part 1562 of this chapter; or (3) an individual authorized to carry a weapon in a sterile area under a security program.",
        "logic_quote": "F005",
        "references": [
          "Paragraph (a)",
          "§§ 1544.219",
          "1544.221",
          "1544.223",
          "1546.211",
          "subpart B of part 1562"
        ],
        "statement": "Paragraph (a) of 49 CFR 1540.111 does not apply to the carriage of firearms and other weapons on or about an individual's person or accessible property if the individual is law enforcement personnel required to carry a weapon on duty at the airport, an individual authorized under specified regulations, or an individual authorized to carry a weapon in a sterile area under a security program."
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F010",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "kind": "prohibition",
        "scope_quotes": [
          "F009"
        ],
        "scope_text": "In checked baggage or in baggage carried in an inaccessible cargo hold under § 1562.23 of this chapter.",
        "context_quotes": [
          "F000"
        ],
        "modality_quote": "may not",
        "modality": "must_not",
        "alternative_quotes": [
          "F009"
        ],
        "choice_quote": "F009",
        "choice_text": "Transport or offer for transport in checked baggage or in baggage carried in an inaccessible cargo hold under § 1562.23 of this chapter.",
        "logic_quote": "F009",
        "references": [
          "§ 1562.23"
        ],
        "statement": "A passenger may not transport or offer for transport in checked baggage or in baggage carried in an inaccessible cargo hold under § 1562.23 of this chapter any loaded firearm(s)."
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F011",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "kind": "prohibition",
        "scope_quotes": [
          "F009",
          "F011:F015"
        ],
        "scope_text": "In checked baggage or in baggage carried in an inaccessible cargo hold under § 1562.23 of this chapter, unless all conditions (i) through (iv) are satisfied.",
        "context_quotes": [
          "F000"
        ],
        "modality_quote": "may not",
        "modality": "must_not",
        "alternative_quotes": [
          "F012",
          "F013",
          "F014",
          "F015"
        ],
        "choice_quote": "F011:F015",
        "choice_text": "All of the following conditions must be satisfied: (i) passenger declares to aircraft operator orally or in writing before checking baggage that passenger has an unloaded firearm in the bag; (ii) firearm is unloaded; (iii) firearm is carried in a hard-sided container; and (iv) container is locked with only the passenger retaining key or combination.",
        "logic_quote": "F014",
        "references": [
          "§ 1562.23"
        ],
        "statement": "A passenger may not transport or offer for transport in checked baggage or in baggage carried in an inaccessible cargo hold under § 1562.23 of this chapter any unloaded firearm(s) unless the passenger declares it to the aircraft operator before checking, the firearm is unloaded, it is carried in a hard-sided container, and the container is locked with only the passenger retaining the key or combination."
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F016",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "kind": "prohibition",
        "scope_quotes": [
          "F009"
        ],
        "scope_text": "In checked baggage or in baggage carried in an inaccessible cargo hold under § 1562.23 of this chapter.",
        "context_quotes": [
          "F000"
        ],
        "modality_quote": "may not",
        "modality": "must_not",
        "alternative_quotes": [],
        "choice_quote": "",
        "choice_text": "",
        "logic_quote": "",
        "references": [
          "§ 1562.23"
        ],
        "statement": "A passenger may not transport or offer for transport in checked baggage or in baggage carried in an inaccessible cargo hold under § 1562.23 of this chapter any unauthorized explosive or incendiary."
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F017",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "kind": "exemption",
        "scope_quotes": [
          "F017"
        ],
        "scope_text": "Governing carriage of ammunition in checked baggage or in the same container as a firearm under 49 CFR 1540.111.",
        "context_quotes": [
          "F009"
        ],
        "modality_quote": "does not prohibit",
        "modality": "not_required",
        "alternative_quotes": [
          "F017"
        ],
        "choice_quote": "F017",
        "choice_text": "In checked baggage or in the same container as a firearm.",
        "logic_quote": "F017",
        "references": [
          "Title 49 CFR part 175"
        ],
        "statement": "49 CFR 1540.111 does not prohibit the carriage of ammunition in checked baggage or in the same container as a firearm, while Title 49 CFR part 175 provides additional requirements governing carriage of ammunition on aircraft."
      }
    }
  ]
}

unit_attributes.scope_text: Except as provided in paragraph (b) of 49 CFR 1540.111, when performance has begun of the inspection of an individual's person or accessible property before entering a sterile area, or before boarding an aircraft for which screening is conducted under this subchapter; when the individual is entering or in a sterile area; or when the individual is attempting to board or onboard an aircraft for which screening is conducted under §§ 1544.201, 1546.201, or 1562.23 of this chapter.
unit_attributes.choice_text: The prohibition applies under any of the following circumstances: (1) when performance has begun of the inspection of the individual's person or accessible property before entering a sterile area, or before boarding an aircraft screened under this subchapter; (2) when entering or in a sterile area; or (3) when attempting to board or onboard an aircraft screened under §§ 1544.201, 1546.201, or 1562.23.
unit_attributes.statement: Except as provided in paragraph (b) of 49 CFR 1540.111, an individual may not have a weapon, explosive, or incendiary, on or about the individual's person or accessible property when inspection has begun before entering a sterile area or boarding a screened aircraft, when entering or in a sterile area, or when attempting to board or onboard a screened aircraft.

unit_attributes.scope_text: Governs carriage of firearms and other weapons on or about an individual's person or accessible property if the individual is one of the qualifying individuals specified in paragraphs (b)(1) through (b)(3).
unit_attributes.choice_text: Paragraph (a) does not apply if the individual is: (1) law enforcement personnel required to carry a firearm or other weapons while in the performance of law enforcement duty at the airport; (2) an individual authorized to carry a weapon in accordance with §§ 1544.219, 1544.221, 1544.223, 1546.211, or subpart B of part 1562 of this chapter; or (3) an individual authorized to carry a weapon in a sterile area under a security program.
unit_attributes.statement: Paragraph (a) of 49 CFR 1540.111 does not apply to the carriage of firearms and other weapons on or about an individual's person or accessible property if the individual is law enforcement personnel required to carry a weapon on duty at the airport, an individual authorized under specified regulations, or an individual authorized to carry a weapon in a sterile area under a security program.

unit_attributes.scope_text: In checked baggage or in baggage carried in an inaccessible cargo hold under § 1562.23 of this chapter.
unit_attributes.choice_text: Transport or offer for transport in checked baggage or in baggage carried in an inaccessible cargo hold under § 1562.23 of this chapter.
unit_attributes.statement: A passenger may not transport or offer for transport in checked baggage or in baggage carried in an inaccessible cargo hold under § 1562.23 of this chapter any loaded firearm(s).

unit_attributes.scope_text: In checked baggage or in baggage carried in an inaccessible cargo hold under § 1562.23 of this chapter, unless all conditions (i) through (iv) are satisfied.
unit_attributes.choice_text: All of the following conditions must be satisfied: (i) passenger declares to aircraft operator orally or in writing before checking baggage that passenger has an unloaded firearm in the bag; (ii) firearm is unloaded; (iii) firearm is carried in a hard-sided container; and (iv) container is locked with only the passenger retaining key or combination.
unit_attributes.statement: A passenger may not transport or offer for transport in checked baggage or in baggage carried in an inaccessible cargo hold under § 1562.23 of this chapter any unloaded firearm(s) unless the passenger declares it to the aircraft operator before checking, the firearm is unloaded, it is carried in a hard-sided container, and the container is locked with only the passenger retaining the key or combination.

unit_attributes.scope_text: In checked baggage or in baggage carried in an inaccessible cargo hold under § 1562.23 of this chapter.
unit_attributes.statement: A passenger may not transport or offer for transport in checked baggage or in baggage carried in an inaccessible cargo hold under § 1562.23 of this chapter any unauthorized explosive or incendiary.

unit_attributes.scope_text: Governing carriage of ammunition in checked baggage or in the same container as a firearm under 49 CFR 1540.111.
unit_attributes.choice_text: In checked baggage or in the same container as a firearm.
unit_attributes.statement: 49 CFR 1540.111 does not prohibit the carriage of ammunition in checked baggage or in the same container as a firearm, while Title 49 CFR part 175 provides additional requirements governing carriage of ammunition on aircraft.
